text: 项目便笺是 DSH 网页客户端的工作区笔记和轻量待办工具。它在对话输入框旁提供面板，按工作区隔离并保存记录；可编辑便笺和任务、筛选任务状态、将文本插入草稿以及导出 Markdown。数据存于当前 DSH 来源的浏览器本地存储，不调用模型、不需 API Key 或外部服务。适合在多个会话间整理项目需求、报错和下一步。

Project Notes adds workspace notes and lightweight tasks to the DSH web client. Its composer-side panel supports editing, task filtering, draft insertion, and Markdown export. Data stays in browser storage for the current DSH origin; no model calls, API key, or external service is needed.
想把每个项目的需求笔记和下一步待办留在 DSH 里。
有没有办法把项目便笺或一条待办放进对话草稿，之后自己确认发送？
I want workspace notes and tasks that I can export as Markdown and reuse in a DSH draft.
项目便笺的功能「工作区笔记与待办」：在输入框旁打开面板，按当前工作区保存便笺和任务；可筛选未完成、已完成或全部任务，编辑和勾选状态。
项目便笺的功能「插入草稿与导出」：从面板插入整篇便笺、选中文字或单条待办到 DSH 草稿，也可将便笺与任务导出为 Markdown 文件。
dsh-project-notes 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 14 天；提交数 4；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

实际插件组件，隔离测试宿主，合成内容。

给每个工作区一张随手写的便笺和一份轻量待办。记需求、报错、临时想法；需要讨论时，一键把文字放进 DSH 输入框。

dsh-project-notes README · 安装与使用：在 DSH「插件 → 添加插件」中填写以下 GitHub 仓库地址（也可使用本地插件目录），启用后按宿主提示重新加载。需要 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2 或更新的 0.2.x**。

```text
https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-everyday-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-project-notes
```

整套安装、迁移和升级步骤见[工具箱安装指南](https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-everyday-plugins/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md)。

输入框旁点击「项目便笺」，顶端显示当前工作区路径。同一路径下的会话共享记录；不同工作区相互隔离。没有工作区时使用「通用便笺」。Windows 路径大小写和结尾斜杠会归一化。

dsh-project-notes README · 安装与使用：- **便笺**：直接编辑，自动保存在本机；支持复制、插入整篇或选中文字。插入保留原光标选区文字，不自动发送。
- **待办**：回车添加、勾选完成、编辑内容；按未完成/已完成/全部筛选，显示完成进度。删除后可撤销最近一条。
- **带入对话**：单条待办可插入当前草稿，再由你确认发送。文字使用官方输入接口，保留原有附件和引用。
- **导出**：将当前便笺和待办导出为 Markdown，未保存的编辑也会包含在导出中。
- 清空当前便笺、批量清理已完成和删除旧工作区记录都需要再次确认。

dsh-project-notes README · 数据与边界：只在当前 DSH 来源的浏览器本地存储保存文字及勾选状态；不调用模型、不读取密钥、不扫描项目文件、不向外发送数据。工作区路径仅用于分组。便笺不会因重命名项目或移动目录自动搬迁；可先导出，再在新工作区粘贴内容。

每个项目便笺最多 48,000 个字符、150 条待办，每条 2,000 个字符；最多 60 个工作区、总计约 800,000 个字符。达到上限时提示整理旧内容，不自动删除你的便笺。文字跨浏览器、DSH 来源和机器不会自动同步。

存储失败时显示错误并保留当前便笺的内存文本，可重试、复制或导出；退出 DSH 会丢失尚未保存的内存编辑。损坏数据不会静默重置。清除 DSH 站点数据会移除插件数据。界面支持中文、英文、深色与浅色主题。

See [English documentation](README.en.md).

dsh-project-notes README · Project Notes：A local notebook and a lightweight checklist for each DeepSeek Harness workspace. Capture requirements, errors and ideas, then insert the useful parts into a draft when you want to discuss them.

dsh-project-notes README · Install and use：Open **Plugins → Add plugin** in DSH and enter the following GitHub repository URL (or a local package directory). Enable and reload when requested. Requires DSH **0.2.1-rc.2 or a newer 0.2.x version**.

```text
https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-everyday-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-project-notes
```

For collection installation, migration and upgrades, see the [installation guide](https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-everyday-plugins/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md#english-quick-guide).

dsh-project-notes README · Install and use：Open **Project notes** beside the composer. The current workspace path appears at the top. Conversations in the same workspace share a notebook; different paths have separate notebooks. Without a workspace, a general notebook is used. Windows path case and trailing slashes are normalized.

dsh-project-notes README · Install and use：- **Notes** autosave locally. Copy or insert the entire note or a selection. Insertion preserves the native selected text and never sends a message.
- **Tasks** support Enter to add, completion checkboxes, editing, open/done/all filters and progress. Undo the most recently deleted task.
- Insert one task into the draft using official composer actions, keeping existing attachments and references.
- Export the note and tasks to Markdown, including any unsaved note text.
- Clearing notebooks, removing completed tasks and deleting old workspace records require confirmation.

dsh-project-notes README · Data and limits：Only text and completion state are stored in local browser storage for the current DSH origin. No model calls, uploads, credential reads or project-file scanning. Workspace paths only group records. Moving a project does not move its notebook automatically: export and paste into the new workspace if needed.

dsh-project-notes README · Data and limits：Up to 60 workspaces, 48,000 note characters per workspace, 150 tasks per workspace, 2,000 characters per task and approximately 800,000 characters overall. Limits produce an error rather than deleting old notes. Different browsers, origins and devices do not synchronize automatically.

dsh-project-notes README · Data and limits：If a write fails, the current note remains in memory and can be retried, copied or exported; quitting DSH loses unsaved in-memory edits. Corrupt local records are not silently reset. Clearing DSH site data removes plugin records. Includes Chinese, English and dark/light theme support.
